note: Montana counties take no business personal property return: taxpayers report to the state Department of Revenue through the TransAction Portal by February 15, and the first $1 million of class 8 market value is exempt. Other county-level business duties, such as lodging occupancy taxes, licenses or clerk filings, were not checked.
